Bump the Node 20 GitHub Actions in the `minds launch-to-first-message` scheduled workflow to their Node 24 majors, matching the versions pinned everywhere else in the repo: `actions/cache/save` and `actions/cache/restore` v4 to v5, `actions/setup-node` v4 to v6, and `actions/upload-artifact` v4 to v7. The v4 majors run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime and emit a deprecation warning in CI.
